leads.issues: Google indexes the homepage as "HOME | My Site" — "My Site" is the default, never-renamed Wix site title, so a searcher looking up 3Z's by name sees no confirmation they've found the right business before they click. The site also still lives on the shared 3zsmobiledetailing.wixsite.com/my-site address rather than a domain of its own, and neither the URL nor the indexed title mentions Dayton, Biddeford, or the wider Maine service area the business actually covers.
leads.opportunity: Renaming the Wix site from "My Site" to "3Z's Mobile Detailing" and rewriting the homepage title to lead with Dayton, ME is a same-day fix that puts the shop's own name — and its strong word-of-mouth reputation — back into its own search listing instead of a generic placeholder.
leads.email_subject: Your homepage is titled "My Site" on Google
leads.email_body:
Hi there,

I was looking at mobile detailers around Dayton and came across 3Z's - saw the review about someone selling their car after a detail and the whole experience being excellent, which is exactly the kind of word-of-mouth that's hard to earn. I checked how the site shows up on Google though, and your homepage is indexed as "HOME | My Site" - "My Site" is the placeholder name Wix gives every new site, and it looks like it was never swapped out for 3Z's. It's also still sitting on the shared wixsite.com address instead of a domain of your own, and nothing in the title mentions Dayton or the surrounding area.

I put together a page showing what I'd fix: https://organic-theory.vercel.app/leads/funnels/2026-07-26-3zs-mobile-detailing.html

More on how I work at https://organic-theory.vercel.app

No pressure at all, just thought a shop with reviews this good deserved a search listing that actually says so.

Gabriel Balenton | Organic Theory Founder
